context_requirements: Antipruritic drugs act on itch sensory neurons or immune mediators; the nine cell lines are non-neuronal cancer lines and lack the relevant target cells.
No annotated molecular targets are listed for this class in the Drug Repurposing Hub, so no direct transcriptional program can be predicted.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that matches a known antipruritic mechanism.
